name: Cool 2 Players Games
summary:
Cool 2 Players Games is a collection of local multiplayer games designed for two players sharing a single Android device. It includes classic games such as Noughts & Crosses, Four in a Row, Dots and Boxes, Chess, Checkers, Ludo, Hangman and Memory Pairs, alongside original quick-play games including Symbol Snap, Pop-Up Croc, Marble Munch and Climb & Slide.

Depending on the game, players can take turns, pass the device between them or play simultaneously on the same screen. The game tracks head-to-head scores, can save player names, colours and shapes, and can be played offline without an account or internet connection.
